research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Neuron23 is researching LRRK2 inhibitors and predictive biomarkers to treat Parkinson's disease. Under titles such as Predictive biomarkers and use thereof to treat Parkinson's disease and LRRK2 inhibitors and uses thereof, and broader Kinase modulators and methods of use thereof, the work focuses on small molecule kinase modulators, including specific tricyclic scaffolds, and biomarker based patient selection for LRRK2 or wild type LRRK2 associated Parkinson's disease. These efforts center on LRRK2 targeted therapeutics and kinase modulation strategies.

product.description: A brain-penetrant, selective inhibitor of LRRK2 designed to treat LRRK2-driven Parkinson’s disease by targeting disease progression mechanisms.

product.name: NEU-111
product.description: A peripherally restricted TYK2 inhibitor in Phase 1 trials targeting immune-mediated inflammatory disorders.

product.description: A central nervous system-penetrant TYK2 inhibitor in preclinical development for neuroinflammatory diseases such as multiple sclerosis.
